Born on 30th May 1955, Paresh Rawal is one of the finest actors in India.
With his outstanding performance in 'Sardar' and films like 'Sir', 'Woh Chokri' that recognised him with the national award.
He was awarded Padma Shri in 2014. He has also won several Filmfare awards.
